notes.title: The Monument Update Has Arrived
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, István here!

Its been a long time coming but version 1.2 is finally here and there's a lot to cover so lets get right to it!

[h1]Monuments[/h1]
Version 1.2 is dubbed the "Monument Update" because I've added 5 monuments to the kingdom of Anceps. Without spoiling too much These monuments grant the player passive buffs, such as health regen or longer shields.

A monument can be found on each of the main levels of the game. By default the monument menu can be accessed with TAB or clicking the Right Stick on the controller.

[h1]Stat reworks[/h1]
How the player's stats (HP, Mana and Stamina) are modified throughout a gameplay session have been changed.
Previously by defeating bosses the player would gain stats and when igniting bonfires would lose mana (this mana was regainable after defeating the area boss).

This system is now completely replaced with a leveling system based on enemy kills. This system allows for a more gradual gain of stats and the possibility to farm levels if someone is stuck on a boss. Every 5th level the damage of the spells gain a small buff as well.

[h1]Other notable changes[/h1]
Thanks to GameMaker Studio 2.3.2 release, an issue with high refresh rate monitors have been solved. Previously this issue meant that anyone running a high refresh rate monitor would only be able to play the game at 45ish FPS instead of the required 60.

9slice now have been applied to every UI box on the screen. This improve the clarity of the UI elements and the overall feel of the game.

Following up with this, the ability to resize the game window while in windows mode have been added. It supports resolutions 720p, 768p, 900p, 1080p and 1440p, but the window can also be manually resized without introducing black bars if the scale is not 16:9.

[h2]Small fixes/changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Slight performance improvements were gained due to GameMaker Studio 2 update.
[*] The camera does not zoom in anymore while talking to NPCs.
[*] Fixes missing gate opening sounds.
[*] Improved the textures of the castle palace.
[*] Various small things I forgot about.
[/list]



I would like to thank every one of you who supports the development of the game for sticking with me for so long. Version 1.2 is the most complete version of Blue Flame to date and I hope you have as much fun playing it as much fun I had making it.

[i]István[/i]

Hi everyone!

To celebrate Blue Flame's 2 month release we're releasing a new patch, Patch #4 (version 1.1.2.1).

notes.title: Patch #2 Hotfix #1 is live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Hotfix #1 for patch #2 (v1.1.0.3) is now live. This contains an update to the tutorial text near the first bonfire. Now this text tells the player that lost mana can be regained by defeating bosses.

I also found an issue with high refresh rate monitors decreasing the framerate of the game. This is a GameMaker Studio 2 bug, and the only way to address this until the bug is fixed is to decrease the monitor's framerate to 60Hz. This fixes the issue of the game not running at 60 FPS - as it should - even when the recommended specifications are met.

I fixed an issue where you can get the Fight for Your Honor! achievement without actually killing the Champion of the Battlefield.

[i]István[/i]

notes.title: Patch #2 (v1.1.0.3) is out!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, István here!

It's time for another regular update of Blue Flame and this time it's a reworked first level. 

[h2]Reworked Last Battlefield[/h2]

The Last Battlefield was the first level ever created to the game and so it needed an update greatly.

The new version retains the level's original premise, but makes it harder to get lost, while still having an open battlefield to explore.

Due to changes in the structure and accessible places in the first level, old saves will not load the new Last Battlefield. To reach the new Last Battlefield you have to start a new game.

[h2]Fixes and Updates[/h2]

The following fixes and updates have also appeared:
[list]
[*] Autosave have been disabled as it could cause issues with being spawn-killed (Spawn killing is bad, m'kay?)
[*] Archers have received updates to their depths and directions, and they won't face east now every time.
[*] Texture prefetching in loading has been segmented to aid with freezing while loading.
[*] Surface sizes have been changed to be a power of 2 to improve performance.
[*] Blinding Light spell has been slightly reworked.
[/list]

[h2]Upcoming Updates[/h2]

In our last patch I promised a Hungarian translation of the game as well. That translation is still coming, but because the reworked Battlefield is a complete package I decided to release it separately.

In the following weeks expect translation to Hungarian, then to other languages as well and updated shadows to the objects of the game. Later down the line a few NPCs might appear in the game.

Until then, don't forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/FSSBlueFlame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/FSSBlueFlame]Facebook[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/Gm6vzEd]Discord[/url] server.

[i]István[/i]

notes.title: Patch #1 (v1.0.5.2) is out!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, István here!

It's been barely a week since the release of Blue Flame, but we're already here with a small content update and a major gameplay improvement.

[h1]Here's whats new in version 1.0.5.2:[/h1]

- Added wisdom to the cracked out wall kitten. Now the kitten will tell a different wisdom every day of the month. Contributed by the [url=https://www.facebook.com/ohgloriouscrackedoutwallkitten/]Oh Glorious Cracked Out Wall Kitten[/url] facebook page.

- Improved the collision system in a way that makes the player unable to be stuck into the enemies. In turn this does mean the player will be able to walk through enemies once in their collision, but it's a small sacrifice for improved gameplay. I'm also looking forward to see how the speedrunning community could use this "phasing" thing.

[h1]Next patch[/h1]

In the next patch I'll try to bring in Hungarian localization and a reworked first level of the game.

Until then, hit us up on [url=https://discord.gg/Gm6vzEd]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/fssblueflame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://facebook.com/fssblueflame]Facebook[/url] or in the community hub.

[i]István[/i]

notes.title: Version 0.5 is out!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm excited to bring you the newest update of Blue Flame, version 0.5! Let's jump right into it with the main course.

[h2]The Forgotten Docks[/h2]

V0.5 opens up a new area called the Forgotten Docks. While currently not implemented this area will unlock the fast travel mechanic of the game that will enable you to travel to the Crossroad Tavern or to the Road to Sikla Castle.

This level also feature a new spell, the Firemine that's perfect for players who would like to lure enemies into traps.
[h2]
Champion of the Battlefield[/h2]

A new boss has arrived to the game! This boss replaces the Daeodon at the beginning of the game and serves as a tutorial boss that teaches the players the importance of blocking and dashing.

[h2]Additions and updates[/h2]

The following have been added/updated in the game:
[list]
[*] Options menu have been added. It's not fully completed yet, but a lot of options (such as particles, screenshake and volumes) can be tweaked.
[*] Added missing animations for Skeleton Halberd and balances.
[*] Crystals now slowly pulse with their lighting.
[*] Spawner bush now has the possibility to delay the spawning of the Crawler enemy.
[*] Taking screenshots with F12 now use a sequential numbering.
[*] Improved the performance of animation rendering.
[*] Updated dialogs to match the lore of the game.
[*] Updated controller view so it reverts back to the player if the Right Stick is not in use.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

The following have been fixed in the game:

[list]
[*] Firesword can no longer hit dead enemies.
[*] Menu can be used with a controller.
[*] About menu buttons now snap correctly.
[*] Fixed an issues that made the potions unable to be picked up if it spawned near a dead Shielder.
[/list]


In the upcoming weeks a new version of the game will come out that will feature a new level of the game as well as the aforementioned fast-travel mechanic.

[i]Steve[/i]

notes.title: Patch 0.4.9.1 Is Out!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Version 4.9.1 is out and while it's only a small increment from version 0.4.9.1 it feels like it should be a whole new, much bigger patch.

Let's get right into it and start with the biggest change, the controller.

[h2]Controller input[/h2]

We are now confident enough in the controller input to remove it from experimental status. While the prompts still show the keyboard input you can now seamlessly switch between using the controller or mouse and keyboard. Further refinements for the controller input (such as rumbling) will arrive in following patches.

The controller layout:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37519229/259c793d82fbc2216df0d077b82e0db5a6ccb73a.png[/img]

[h2]Updates and Polishes[/h2]

In the latest patch the following things have been updated and/or polished:

[list]
[*][b] UPDATED MAIN MENU[/b] - The menu now contains the new key art and switching to full screen snaps the buttons to the lower left corner
[*] [b]EXPLODING SKELETON[/b] - A new enemy appeared in the Cemetery of the Ignoble, a skeleton that rises from the ground and charges the player.
[*] The Options, saves and screenshots folder is now located un User/AppData/Local/Blue_Flame as opposed to User/AppData/Local/BlueFlame_GMS2
[*] Input controller has been reworked so that the player now can switch seamlessly between mouse and keyboard or controller.
[*] Controller camera movement has been adjusted in a way that it reverts back to the player if the right stick is not used.
[*] A quick boss tease against the Maggot of the Underworld has been added to the Last Battlefield
[*] Crystal lights are now more dynamic, changing in size and color.
[*] Halberd Skeleton now has proper attack and death animations, with correct attack range and angle.
[*] Added grass to Aaron's garden in the Crossroad Tavern.
[*] When changing rooms the selected spell now stays the same. Before it reverted back to Combustion.
[*] Bushes now can be traversed if burnt.
[*] Controller setting screen has been removed as it is now obsolete.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

The following fixes have been added:

[list]
[*] Daeodon has been banished from the Last Battlefield [strike]to the Shadow Realm[/strike] for causing a crash to desktop.
[*] Fixed hitboxes of the graves.
[*] Reworked save/load system to circumvent an issues with spells resetting after entering the Cemetery of the Ignoble
[/list]

There is currently a known issue with the "About the Demo" screen's buttons not snapping correctly to the bottom left. I'm working on it.


[h2]What's next?[/h2]

Hopefully in the following weeks I'll be able to get a new sub-level to the game that acts as a quick-travel point as well as the long awaited options menu. High on the priority list is also the rework of the intro.

I hope You'll have fun in the latest update of Blue Flame

[i]Steve[/i]

notes.title: Patch 0.4.5.2 released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Steve here!

This version of the game is the penultimate before the Steam Demo rolls out on the 9th of June, so let's see what's changed!

[h1]Shifting Woods[/h1]

Hands down the most important change is the rework of the Shifting Woods level, with the addition of moving trees. Explore the new level and try not to get lost in it. With this level rework Wassa received a buff as well and got regenerative properties. Loremaster Sebastian arrived in this reworked Forest as well, he might tell you a thing or two about how to defeat the improved Wassa.

[h1]Save/Load system[/h1]

A Save/Load system has been added to the game. As of right now hitting ESC while playing saves the game and returns to the title screen. Clicking on the Continue button returns you to the game - as expected - but starting a new game erases the current save file. There's only one save file right now, but in the future, there will be multiple. 

With this the persistent levels have been turned off, so you can start new playthroughs of the game without having to restart it. There might be some bugs in the save system, especially if you're dying in a room without an activated bonfire.

[h1]Changes[/h1]

Let's get into the smaller changes:

[list]
[*] New sounds have been added to the game, including hurt and death sound effects for Daeodon
[*] Killing Daeodon now triggers a camera toggle so we can always see him die.
[*] Footstep sounds have been decreased.
[*] Potion pickups have been reworked. Now there's a potion dropped on the ground when an enemy is killed (and it can give a potion) but that potion can only be picked up if there's no aggroed enemy nearby.
[*] Fixed various camera issues, talking with NPCs now has a smaller zoom in.
[*] Textboxes now don't disappear automatically, but a close popup appears once the NPC is done talking.
[*] Dot product have been disabled, this means that when fighting enemies you no longer walk when going backward.
[*] HP bar now flashes white when you're hit (the final polish of this is currently a work in progress)
[*] Two new small levels have been added that currently serve as end-of-demo levels. Later they will lead to new areas in the game.
[*] Fixed various bugs and instabilities.
[/list]


[h1]Known issues[/h1]

[list]
[*] Moving trees can get into the way of the player.
[*] Attack dogs can jump through fences and run away. #cowards
[*] Footsteps for the attack dogs are not perfect yet.
[/list]


There's less than a week until the demo of Blue Flame is out, that will feature three levels, I hope you're as excited as I am.

[i]Steve[/i]

notes.title: Patch 0.4.5.1 released

A small patch has been deployed that fixes the following issues:

[list]
[*] Bosses can no longer be killed without them aggroing (The Spooky Man)
[*] Fixed CTD after Wassa is killed and the being of light is still present (The Spooky Man)
[*] After running away from archers they stop chasing the player (Arkanio)

[/list]

[h3]New Stuff:[/h3]

[/list]

[h3]Known issues:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game can only truly be restarted by restarting the whole app. This is due to the persistent level. (The Spooky Man)
[*] In the second intro scene there's overlapping of talking sound effects.
[*] Performance issues with the particles (Arkanio)
[/list]


I would like to thank our community members for uncovering these bugs If you too would like to participate, join our [url=https://discord.gg/UK5S4f6]Discord[/url] group and let us know you're interested.


Steve
